scope.title: What an unsubscribe link stops
scope.description: contact: every alert for that address (and future API sign-ups); subscription: only that alert.

page_url.title: Your own confirm page
page_url.description: https URL with a {token} placeholder; your page calls POST /v1/unsubscribe. Empty = the hosted confirm page.

resubscribe_lifts_suppression.title: A new sign-up with consent lifts an unsubscribe
resubscribe_lifts_suppression.description: Off: an unsubscribed address can only be re-enabled by the merchant.
